note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997); the original states that no alate specimens were available and that the alates recorded by Snyder (1934) may not belong to this species, so that section gives only king and queen measurements; the minor worker is marked not available in the original; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Major soldier body length 12.5–13.0 mm, mandibles about 2.2 mm long, about half the head length, apex weakly incurved; minor soldier body length about 7.0 mm, mandibles 1.40–1.68 mm long; major worker head length from the base of the labrum 1.75–2.05 mm, posterior margin of pronotum distinctly emarginate.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule pale chestnut brown; antennae brownish; labrum pale chestnut brown; mandibles dark brown, paler at the base; pronotum brownish; remainder of body paler than the pronotum. Pilosity of head and body sparse; posterior margin of each abdominal tergite with a row of hairs. Body length 12.5–13.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate; broader posteriorly, narrowed anteriorly (length to base of mandibles 3.90–4.60 mm, maximum width 3.20–3.65 mm, width/length ratio 0.782, minimum width/maximum width ratio 0.611). Fontanelle small, circular, situated at the middle of the head. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segments 2 and 4; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2. Labrum subtriangular, ligulate, reaching the middle of the mandibles; apex transparent, triangular, acute. Mandibles strong and thick, falcate, about 2.2 mm long, about half the head length; apex weakly incurved. Left mandible with teeth on the basal half, the proximal one larger and decreasing anteriorly; right mandible without teeth. Postmentum long, subquadrate, with a long waist (length 3.10 mm, maximum width 0.90 mm, waist width 0.65 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin distinctly concave (length 1.30–1.40 mm, width 2.30–2.50 mm). Posterolateral margins of mesonotum and metanotum convex. Minor soldier: head capsule pale chestnut brown; antennae and body yellowish brown; mandibles dark chestnut brown with a reddish tinge. Pilosity of head and body sparse. Body length about 7.0 mm. Head subquadrate (length to base of mandibles 2.20–2.60 mm, maximum width 1.80–2.10 mm). Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3 and nearly equal to segment 2. Labrum narrow, ligulate, pale chestnut brown and with long hairs, reaching two thirds of the mandibles; apex transparent, triangular. Mandibles slender, falcate, apex incurved (length 1.40–1.68 mm). Left mandible with teeth extending to half the mandible length; right mandible without teeth. Postmentum subquadrate, narrow and long (length 1.60–1.75 mm, maximum width 0.63–0.65 mm, waist width 0.50 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin distinctly concave (length 0.80 mm, width 1.25 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head and postclypeus pale brown; antennae and thorax yellowish brown; abdominal tergites paler than the thorax, sternites whitish. Pilosity sparse. Body length about 6.8–7.8 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to apex of labrum 2.4–2.8 mm, length to base of mandibles 1.75–2.05 mm, maximum width 2.05–2.40 mm). Fontanelle small, circular, transparent. Compound eye represented by a whitish oval patch. Antennae 17–18-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 equal to segment 2 when 17-segmented, shorter than segment 2 when 18-segmented. Postclypeus inflated, length less than half its width (length 0.35–0.38 mm, width 1.00–1.05 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior lobe large, anterior margin not concave; posterior margin distinctly concave (length 0.73–0.88 mm, width 1.10–1.30 mm). Mesonotum narrow, metanotum wider than the pronotum. Minor worker: not described in the original.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Alate: no alate of this species was available; measurements are given only from a king and queen collected in copula: head length to base of mandibles 2.00–2.30 mm, head width 2.60–2.70 mm, compound eye diameter 0.87 mm, ocellus major axis 0.34–0.36 mm, distance from compound eye to lower margin of head 0.05 mm, distance from compound eye to ocellus 0.15–0.16 mm, pronotum length 1.50 mm, width 2.30–2.40 mm.
